extracted.name: Unbelievable Chicken
extracted.description: Your taste buds will love this exciting blend of brown sugar, cider vinegar, garlic, mustard, lemon, and lime in this easy marinade for juicy chicken.
instruction_lines: Mix cider vinegar, mustard, garlic, lime juice, lemon juice, brown sugar, salt, and pepper together in a large glass or ceramic bowl. Whisk in olive oil. Add chicken and toss evenly to coat. Cover, and marinate in the refrigerator for 8 hours to overnight.
Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat.
Lightly oil the grill grate. Place chicken on the preheated grill, and cook 6 to 8 minutes per side, until juices run clear. Discard any remaining marinade.
